title: Add a rule: other states
summary: The Add a rule dialog's states beyond licenses.access-rule: a group no sign-in has sent yet (saves, matches no one), a duplicate of an existing rule (inline error with Edit that rule), a blank group after Add rule, the match preview counting, and the preview failing with Retry.
compare: A board of dialogs (.board.cols-2.wide-3): two a row from 1280px, three at wide, one below; each draws only the fields its state needs.
Matches no one: Group djdl-press-eu; a warning 'No one has djdl-press-eu yet' / 'The rule still saves. Check the name matches Pocket ID’s exactly, including case.'; Add rule enabled.
Duplicate: under Group, 'studio-pro from Pocket ID already gives Studio. Edit that rule instead.'; Add rule disabled.
Blank group: 'Enter the group name exactly as Pocket ID sends it.' under the empty, focused field.
Preview counting: skeleton head and two skeleton rows in the preview slot; a live region announces the count.
Preview failed: 'Couldn’t count who has djdl-press' / 'Polaris Key didn’t answer in time. The rule still saves.' with Retry.

designReview.reviewer: Spacing and content pass against the products.overview and products.home references, all four sizes in both themes
designReview.verdict: Spacing and content pass: the same dialog parts as licenses.access-rule on the kit board; 0 screen spacing.

findings.issue: 10 spacing declarations and custom rows for the preview and its skeleton.
Errors and callouts ran to two or three sentences; captions repeated them.
findings.resolution: One sentence of what happened and one of what to do; captions one line.

findings.issue: Dialog footers 36px and helper text under 13px.
findings.resolution: Footers are .dialog-foot.std (40px buttons, 12px gap); the board is .floor (13px helpers).

findings.issue: Rewrite the warning, error and loading copy.
findings.resolution: declined: The copy already follows the 'what happened, what to do' rule. The change is wording only.
